summary: Frontend-only regression test after extracting the per-product row into /app/frontend/src/components/CapoProductRow.jsx. Desktop 1920x800, admin@mikilab.de login, planner reached via localStorage 'mikilab_pending_tool'='pianoai' + nav-tab-maestro. RESULT: ALL PASS, no regression. (1) RECIPE PICKER (single): capo-product-recipe-0-trigger opens the category modal (6 category cards, Favorites first), no checkboxes and no '-done' button (single-select confirmed); clicking a recipe item CLOSES the modal and the trigger label updates to the exact recipe name ('Cooked Flour (Kochstueck)...'). (2) QUANTITY: capo-product-qty-0 = 42 persists; suffix 'pieces' (EN) and switches to 'kg' when unit=kg. (3) OPTIONS: capo-product-opts-0 reveals unit/gpp/day selects; unit=kg removes capo-product-gpp-0 (count 0) and changes qty suffix to 'kg'; back to pezzi restores gpp (value 80 persists); day select works (value 'mar'). (4) DAY CHIP: capo-product-daychip-0 shows 'Tuesday'; after collapsing Options (button label 'Less') the day <select> is gone but the chip remains; clicking the chip re-expands Options with day='mar'; setting day back to 'Any day' removes the chip. (5) START HERE: capo-product-start-<i> only renders when a recipe is selected (absent on the empty row); clicking row0 sets 'Starting dough', clicking row1 moves it (row0 reverts to 'Start here') => single-start rule intact; re-click toggles off. (6) PER-ROW ISOLATION: qty row0=10 / row1=55 independent, distinct recipe labels, expanding Options on row1 does not expand row0, unit=kg on row1 leaves row0 suffix 'pieces'. (7) REMOVE/ADD: removing row0 (X) leaves 1 row that correctly carries row1's recipe + qty 55 (index shift correct); capo-product-add appends an empty row. (8) COMBOS REGRESSION: capo-combos panel visible, save-open/name/save stores combo in localStorage mikilab_combos with full item payload, chip 'TEST_Refactor . 1' appears, apply after clearing all rows restores the row (recipe + qty 55), capo-combo-del-<id> removes chip and storage becomes []. (9) BULK PICKER: capo-add-picker-trigger + 2 distinct items + capo-add-picker-done adds 2 rows with default qty 10 (when a selected recipe already exists in the list it is deduped -> only new rows added; pre-existing behavior). No pageerror/JS crash; body background rgb(18,18,18) with #FF6B00 accents intact.
